name: carbon-arc-location-intelligence
description: Analyze venues and metro areas with Carbon Arc data. Built to keep you in control: iterate and explore as you normally would, or ask it to run straight through. Two reports: a venue report for those who run or book arenas, stadiums and theaters, and a place report comparing a metro area with its peers, for market researchers. Try: "Build a venue report on [venue]." "Which shows drive resale prices at [venue]?" "What did [event] do to [city]'s economy?"
